Hugh Garfield is my name; my age twenty-nine, and I am the son of the late Reverend Francis Garfield, rector of Aldingbourne and minor canon of Chichester. In the war I served with the Royal Air Force and obtained my pilot's certificate. I went to France and afterwards to Italy, and on being demobilized returned to my work as an electrical engineer in the employ of Messrs.

55240-more-italian-yesterdays.title: Italian Yesterdays
55240-more-italian-yesterdays.creator: Mrs. Hugh Fraser
55240-more-italian-yesterdays.description: A book by Mrs. Hugh Fraser. The Pantheon—Hadrian’s best monument—Long idle—Consecrated   as St. Mary of the Martyrs—The Cathedral, the   symbol of the soul—Its purification—Continuity of the   Church—A priest’s visit—The alabaster square—Procession   of the martyr’s relics—Giovanni Borgi, the workman—Italian   Guilds—Giovanni’s selflessness—His rescue of   the forsaken children—Care of them—Crusade in behalf   of all the waifs of Rome—His work of love—Giovanni’s   successor, later Pius IX pp.

arxiv-2103-01512.title: A model consistent with LQCD data on ρ \rho -meson screening mass
arxiv-2103-01512.creator: Masahiro Ishii, Akihisa Miyahara, Hiroaki Kouno, Masanobu Yahiro
arxiv-2103-01512.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Masahiro Ishii, Akihisa Miyahara, Hiroaki Kouno, Masanobu Yahiro. Recently, state-of-art LQCD calculations were done for π \pi -meson and ρ \rho -meson screening mass, M π scr ​ ( T ) {M_{\pi}^{\rm scr}}(T) and M ρ scr ​ ( T ) {M_{\rho}^{\rm scr}}(T) . We consider the two-flavor system, and focus on temperature dependence T T of M π scr ​ ( T ) {M_{\pi}^{\rm scr}}(T) and M ρ scr ​ ( T ) {M_{\rho}^{\rm scr}}(T) .

arxiv-2110-00375.title: Fully Spiking Variational Autoencoder
arxiv-2110-00375.creator: Hiromichi Kamata, Yusuke Mukuta, Tatsuya Harada
arxiv-2110-00375.description: Abstract Spiking neural networks (SNNs) can be run on neuromorphic devices with ultra-high speed and ultra-low energy consumption because of their binary and event-driven nature. Therefore, SNNs are expected to have various applications, including as generative models being running on edge devices to create high-quality images.

arxiv-2110-14752.title: Role of bound states and resonances in scalar QFT at nonzero temperature
arxiv-2110-14752.creator: Subhasis Samanta, Francesco Giacosa
arxiv-2110-14752.description: Abstract We study the thermal properties of quantum field theories (QFT) with three-leg interaction vertices g ​ φ 3 g\varphi^{3} and g ​ S ​ φ 2 gS\varphi^{2} ( φ \varphi and S S being scalar fields), which constitute the relativistic counterpart of the Yukawa potential.

arxiv-2207-14658.title: Star-Planet Interaction:
arxiv-2207-14658.creator: C. Fischer, J. Saur
arxiv-2207-14658.description: Abstract Context. Electromagnetic Star-Planet Interaction (SPI) describes the phenomenon, when a planet couples to its host star via electromagnetic forces. Alfvén waves can establish such a coupling by forming Alfvén wings. SPI allows phenomena that we do not know from the Solar System. Wing-wing interaction is such an example, where the Alfvén wings of two planets merge and interact non-linearly.

arxiv-2208-12480.title: Need for Design Patterns: Interoperability Issues and Modelling Challenges for Observational Data
arxiv-2208-12480.creator: Trupti Padiya, Frank Löffler, Friederike Klan
arxiv-2208-12480.description: Abstract Interoperability issues concerning observational data have gained attention in recent times. Automated data integration is important when it comes to the scientific analysis of observational data from different sources. However, it is hampered by various data interoperability issues. We focus exclusively on semantic interoperability issues for observational characteristics.

arxiv-2305-11939.title: Fate of multipolar physics in 5 ​ d 2 5d^{2} double perovskites
arxiv-2305-11939.creator: Ahmed Rayyan 1 , Xiaoyu Liu 2 , Hae-Young Kee 1,3
arxiv-2305-11939.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ahmed Rayyan 1 , Xiaoyu Liu 2 , Hae-Young Kee 1,3. In a cubic environment, the ground state of spin-orbit coupled 5 ​ d 2 5d^{2} ions is a non-Kramers E g E_{g} doublet, which hosts quadrupole and octupole moments. A series of 5 ​ d 2 5d^{2} osmium double perovskites Ba M 2 {}_{2}M OsO 6 (M = Mg, Ca, Zn, Cd) have recently been proposed to exhibit multipolar orders.

arxiv-2306-09869.title: Energy-Based Cross Attention for Bayesian Context Update in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
arxiv-2306-09869.creator: Geon Yeong Park, Jeongsol Kim, Beomsu Kim, Sang Wan Lee, Jong Chul Ye
arxiv-2306-09869.description: Abstract Despite the remarkable performance of text-to-image diffusion models in image generation tasks, recent studies have raised the issue that generated images sometimes cannot capture the intended semantic contents of the text prompts, which phenomenon is often called semantic misalignment.

arxiv-2308-14670.title: Symmetric Models for Visual Force Policy Learning
arxiv-2308-14670.creator: Colin Kohler, Anuj Shrivatsav Srikanth, Eshan Arora, Robert Platt
arxiv-2308-14670.description: Abstract While it is generally acknowledged that force feedback is beneficial to robotic control, applications of policy learning to robotic manipulation typically only leverage visual feedback. Recently, symmetric neural models have been used to significantly improve the sample efficiency and performance of policy learning across a variety of robotic manipulation domains.

arxiv-2311-01942.title: From conductance viewed as transmission to resistance viewed as reflection. An extension of Landauer quantum paradigm to the classical case at finite temperature
arxiv-2311-01942.creator: Lino Reggiani, Eleonora Alfinito, Federico Intini
arxiv-2311-01942.description: Abstract In this paper we present an extension of Landauer paradigm, conductance is transmission, to the case of macroscopic classical conductors making use of a description of conductance and resistance based on the application of the fluctuation dissipation (FD) theorem.

arxiv-2403-08374.title: Efficient Signature-Free Validated Agreement
arxiv-2403-08374.creator: Pierre Civit, Muhammad Ayaz Dzulfikar, Seth Gilbert, Rachid Guerraoui, Jovan Komatovic, Manuel Vidigueira, Igor Zablotchi
arxiv-2403-08374.description: Abstract Byzantine agreement enables n n processes to agree on a common L L -bit value, despite up to t > 0 t>0 arbitrary failures. A long line of work has been dedicated to improving the bit complexity of Byzantine agreement in synchrony.

arxiv-2409-02147.title: Anisotropic pressure effect on central EOS of PSR J0740+6620 in the light of dimensionless TOV equation
arxiv-2409-02147.creator: Zhihao Yang, Dehua Wen
arxiv-2409-02147.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zhihao Yang, Dehua Wen. It is generally agreed upon that the pressure inside a neutron star is isotropic. However, a strong magnetic field or superfluidity suggests that the pressure anisotropy may be a more realistic model. We derived the dimensionless TOV equation for anisotropic neutron stars based on two popular models, namely the BL model and the H model, to investigate the effect of anisotropy.

arxiv-2504-19781.title: Non-reflexivity of the Banach space
arxiv-2504-19781.creator: Λ
arxiv-2504-19781.description: Abstract Abstract. In this paper, we present a surprising finding that demonstrates the non-reflexivity of the Waterman-Shiba space. Previously, Prus-Wi \rm\acute{s} niowski and Ruckle [ 3 ] extended the classical result showing that the space of functions of bounded variation is non-reflexive. Our work offers a refinement and strengthening of this earlier result.

arxiv-2508-04145.description: Abstract . In modern online platforms, search and recommendation ( S&R ) often coexist, offering opportunities for performance improvement through search-enhanced approaches. Existing studies show that incorporating search signals boosts recommendation performance. However, the effectiveness of these methods relies heavily on rich search interactions.

arxiv-2509-12312.title: Origin of the double-peaked narrow emission-lines in the optical spectra of X-shaped Radio Galaxies
arxiv-2509-12312.creator: Prajnadipt Ghosh, Ravi Joshi, Xiaolong Yang, Yingkang Zhang, Gopal-Krishna, Paul J. Wiita, Ankit Patel, Arti Goyal, Gourab Giri, Santanu Mondal, Vibhore Negi, Marek Weżgowiec, Xue-Bing Wu, Luis C. Ho
arxiv-2509-12312.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Prajnadipt Ghosh, Ravi Joshi, Xiaolong Yang, Yingkang Zhang, Gopal-Krishna, Paul J. Wiita, Ankit Patel, Arti Goyal, Gourab Giri, Santanu Mondal, Vibhore Negi, Marek Weżgowiec, Xue-Bing Wu, Luis C. Ho. We investigate the X-shaped radio galaxies (XRGs) with optical double-peaked narrow emission (DPNEL) as potential hosts of dual or binary supermassive black holes (SMBHs).

arxiv-2510-13599.title: PlanarMesh: Building Compact 3D Meshes from LiDAR using Incremental Adaptive Resolution Reconstruction
arxiv-2510-13599.creator: Jiahao Wang, Nived Chebrolu, Yifu Tao, Lintong Zhang, Ayoung Kim, Maurice Fallon
arxiv-2510-13599.description: Abstract Building an online 3D LiDAR mapping system that produces a detailed surface reconstruction while remaining computationally efficient is a challenging task. In this paper, we present PlanarMesh, a novel incremental, mesh-based LiDAR reconstruction system that adaptively adjusts mesh resolution to achieve compact, detailed reconstructions in real-time.

arxiv-2601-05412.title: Detection of the 2021 Arid Meteor Shower on Maunakea, Hawai’i
arxiv-2601-05412.creator: Ichi Tanaka, \altemailmark \orcid 0000-0002-4937-4738 Hitoshi Hasegawa, Toyokazu Uda, Mikiya Sato, Jun-ichi Watanabe and Masanobu Higashiyama

pmc-11403364.title: Lebrikizumab Combined with Topical Corticosteroids Improves Patient-reported Outcomes in Japanese Patients with Moderate-to-severe Atopic Dermatitis
pmc-11403364.creator: Akio TANAKA, Ken IGAWA, Hidetoshi TAKAHASHI, Ryosuke SHIMIZU, Yoko KATAOKA, Hitoe TORISU-ITAKURA, Yoji MORISAKI, Sonia MONTMAYEUR, Norito KATOH
pmc-11403364.description: Lebrikizumab has previously demonstrated efficacy in Phase 3 trials: ADvocate1 and ADvocate2 (as monotherapy), ADhere, and ADhere-J (in combination with topical corticosteroids). Here, the impact of lebrikizumab combined with low- to mid-potency topical corticosteroids on patient-reported outcomes at 16 weeks in Japanese patients with moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis is evaluated.

pmc-11429478.title: Increased viperin expression induced by avian infectious bronchitis virus inhibits viral replication by restricting cholesterol synthesis: an in vitro study
pmc-11429478.creator: Yu Zhang, Tao-Ni Zhang, Yan-Peng Lu, Li-Na Ren, Sheng-Ting Chen, Ling Liu, Lan-Ping Wei, Ji-Ming Chen, Jian-Ni Huang, Mei-Lan Mo
pmc-11429478.description: With the emergence of new variant strains resulting from high mutation rates and genome recombination, avian infectious bronchitis virus (IBV) has caused significant economic losses to the poultry industry worldwide. Little is known about the underlying mechanisms of IBV-host interactions, particularly how IBV utilizes host metabolic pathways for efficient viral replication and transmission.

pmc-11506272.title: Development of an MRI Radiomic Machine-Learning Model to Predict Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Based on Fibroglandular Tissue of the Contralateral Unaffected Breast in Breast Cancer Patients
pmc-11506272.creator: Roberto Lo Gullo, Rosa Elena Ochoa-Albiztegui, Jayasree Chakraborty, Sunitha B Thakur, Mark Robson, Maxine S Jochelson, Keitha Varela, Daphne Resch, Sarah Eskreis-Winkler, Katja Pinker, Jonas Cicenas, Yun-Chung Cheung, Yao Melissa Min-Szu, Chung Wai-Shan
pmc-11506272.description: Simple SummaryTriple-negative breast cancer is the most aggressive breast cancer subtype. However, women at risk for developing triple-negative breast cancer may not be identified by existing risk models. Thus, we present a study to determine if triple-negative breast cancer can be predicted based on a radiomic analysis and the machine-learning features of the fibroglandular tissue of the contralateral unaffected breast.

pmc-11511210.title: Impact of Mask Type as Training Target for Speech Intelligibility and Quality in Cochlear-Implant Noise Reduction
pmc-11511210.creator: Fergal Henry, Martin Glavin, Edward Jones, Ashkan Parsi, Richard J Povinelli
pmc-11511210.description: The selection of a target when training deep neural networks for speech enhancement is an important consideration. Different masks have been shown to exhibit different performance characteristics depending on the application and the conditions. This paper presents a comprehensive comparison of several different masks for noise reduction in cochlear implants.

pmc-12454028.title: Screening and characterization of DNA aptamers that modulate prime editing
pmc-12454028.creator: Mingxia Wang, Xia Wu, Xinbo Huang, Jing Ye, Yaoting Gui
pmc-12454028.description: IntroductionPrecise genome editing is a critical focus in gene therapy, and the CRISPR-Cas9 system has become a powerful and versatile tool for this purpose. However, a significant limitation of the CRISPR-Cas9 system is its low homologous recombination rate, which can impede the restoration of normal gene function.

pmc-13182106.creator: Yulan Song, Rongwei Ren, Ruxuan Li, Mingyang Zou, Yixin Pan, Jiebin Pan, Changpeng Chai
pmc-13182106.description: BackgroundEsophagogastric variceal bleeding (EGVB) is a life-threatening complication of decompensated cirrhosis that imposes a substantial inpatient economic burden. However, the specific determinants and cost composition of EGVB hospitalization remain poorly defined in China.MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed 122 patients admitted with EGVB between April 2019 and July 2023 at the First Hospital of Lanzhou University.

pmc-13313890.creator: Asmaa Bouknine, Mira Chiraoui, Abdelhak Bouknine, Hemida Houari, Sidi Ali Selmani
pmc-13313890.description: Background:The spleen plays a vital role in the regulation of immunity and blood complete splenectomy can increase vulnerability to infection, whereas partial splenectomy preserves function. However, the ability of residual tissue to regenerate remains uncertain.Aim:Hematological and histological evaluation of spleen regeneration following partial splenectomy in Algerian rabbits.
